events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From the Ministry of Silly Walks to Basil Fawlty's exasperation, John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite moment from a true British comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. Double album, double the genius. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, a voice that truly transcended generations. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Classic Album
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose message of peace continues to resonate. His music lives on.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic musician and cultural chameleon, David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Forever pushing boundaries. Today we celebrate the life and legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King of Rock and Roll, always. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today. What's your all-time favourite Rod the Mod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy
angles.copy: One step beyond! Suggs from Madness turns 66 today. What's your favourite tune from the undisputed kings of ska-pop?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: The smooth, soulful voice of Paul Young turns 71 today! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Every Time You Go Away', what's your top Paul Young track?

events.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and incredible music of Dolly Parton. A true legend.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Gary Barlow, best known as the lead vocalist of Take That, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, what's your favourite track from the pop maestro?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get celebrating! Billy Ocean turns 77 today. What's the song that always gets you moving?

events.title: Anniversary of the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in New York City, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Beginnings
angles.copy: It's 41 years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction! Which legendary artist from that inaugural class is still your go-to?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his solo career, what's your favourite Mark moment or song?
